item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Silent Hill: Music From The Otherworld (Expanded Edition) [2012]
item.description:
Silent Hill: Music From The Otherworld (Expanded Edition) is my personal compilation of songs composed by Akira Yamaoka and Daniel Licht with vocals by Mary Elizabeth McGlynn and Joe Romersa. This is a project I love so much and started a year ago. It consists on 32 tracks selected from the soundtracks of Silent Hill 3, Silent Hill 4: The Room, Silent Hill: Origins, Silent Hill: Homecoming, Silent Hill: Shattered Memories, Silent Hill: Book of Memories, Silent Hill: Revelation and Silent Hill Sounds Box. It is an extended version for Silent Hill: Music From The Otherworld which contains tracks previously unlisted: unreleased or in-game versions. The album covers were designed by myself. Hope you enjoy it!

Tracklist:

01. Lost Carol (From Silent Hill 3)
02. You're Not Here (From Silent Hill 3)
03. Shot Down In Flames (From Silent Hill: Origins)
04. Your Rain (From Silent Hill 4: The Room)
05. Love Psalm (From Silent Hill: Book of Memories)
06. Alex Theme (From Silent Hill: Homecoming)
07. Always On My Mind (From Silent Hill: Shattered Memories)
08. Room of Angel (From Silent Hill 4: The Room)
09. Silent Scream (From Silent Hill: Revelation)
10. When You're Gone (From Silent Hill: Shattered Memories)
11. O.R.T. (In-Game Version) [From Silent Hill: Origins]
12. One More Soul To The Call (From Silent Hill: Homecoming)
13. Letter From The Lost Days (From Silent Hill 3)
14. Tender Sugar (From Silent Hill 4: The Room)
15. I Want Love (Studio Mix) [From Silent Hill 3]
16. Hole In The Sky (In-Game Version) [From Silent Hill: Origins]
17. Hell Frozen Rain (From Silent Hill: Shattered Memories)
18. Now We're Free (From Silent Hill: Book of Memories)
19. Walk On Vanity Ruins (From Silent Hill 3)
20. Joe Sweet Dreams (From Silent Hill Sounds Box)
21. Hometown (From Silent Hill 3)
22. Cradle of Forest (From Silent Hill 4: The Room)
23. Elle Theme (From Silent Hill: Homecoming)
24. Blow Back (From Silent Hill: Origins)
25. This Sacred Line (From Silent Hill: Homecoming)
26. Acceptance (From Silent Hill: Shattered Memories)

Bonus Tracks:

27. Lost Carol (Long Version) [From Silent Hill Sounds Box]
28. I Want Love (In-Game Version) [From Silent Hill 3]
29. Alex Theme (Machine Head Mix) [From Silent Hill: Homecoming]
30. Tender Sugar (Empire Mix) [From Silent Hill 4: The Room Limited Edition]
31. Your Rain (Rage Mix) [From Silent Hill 4: The Room Limited Edition]
